text: ムキに　なっちゃって！

structure.jp: ムキに　なっちゃって！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, 'ended up doing'; stopping at て leaves the sentence hanging in a teasing way. ムキに なっちゃって = 'look at you, getting all worked up'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: ムキに　なっちゃって
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means 'become' that thing. ムキに なる = 'get worked up'.
